neighbours.label: the first word of a cited work's title right after 'book', 'paper', 'thesis' or a citation year
fire: She is best known for her book Silent Spring, which changed how people saw pesticides.
In his thesis Turbulence in shallow channels he measured flow over gravel beds.
The results appear in the paper Learning to see in the dark by a team from Toronto.
Smith, John (1998). Rivers of the northern plains. Lincoln: University Press.
He later published the textbook Practical Anatomy for nursing students.
Her recent memoir Night Shifts describes ten years in an emergency room.
The essay Why we sleep was reprinted in several anthologies.
Read the report Ocean warming and coral loss before the seminar.
quiet: She is best known for her book about pesticides, which changed how people saw farming.
In his thesis he measured the flow of water over gravel beds in shallow channels.
The results appear in a paper by a team from Toronto about seeing in the dark.
John Smith spent 1998 studying the rivers of the northern plains near Lincoln.
He later wrote a practical textbook on anatomy for nursing students.
Her recent memoir describes ten years of night shifts in an emergency room.
The essay about sleep was reprinted in several anthologies.
Read the report about ocean warming and coral loss before the seminar.

notes: Card: peaks on 'In|numeracy', ' History', ' Military', ' Stability', ' What' right after 'book', 'textbook', 'thesis', 'paper', '(2001).'. Output suppresses title openers (' How', ' Understanding', ' Managing') for the - pole side.
